line.comment: * DESCRIPTION: Test if a ship is a carrier AND is huge.
* Confirmed: max number already has the -1 factored in. It's if a variable is used as max bound is when it is subtracted by 1.
* Check if the ship is captureable. If the notCaptureable flag isn't set, then it's a valid ship.
* Roll a 1-in-3 chance. If it passes, start flying to the ship.
* Move until within 3km, then allow a 6km claim buffer for pathing drift, matching tug behavior.
* Final check: Must still be neutral and within claim range.
* If claimed, restore equipment, just in case. Remove bailed flags.
* Add-Ons 1.13.1: Claimed ships are now repaired to 65% if below 65% hull.
